<summary>How To Install</summary>

- First Install The Modrinth App(if you have modrinth already go to step 3)
- Then Sign Into Your Minecraft Account
- Click On The Search Icon
- Then Search [**VertiCast**]
- Click On Install
- Go to The Home Screen
- Click On My ModPack
- Then Play 
- ENJOY (the most important step)
